title: Chapter 60 Ao Qing Was Expelled From The Dragon Clan
content:
Chapter 60 Ao Qing Was Expelled From The Dragon Clan

Hearing this question, the dragons also looked at Ao Qing.

Looking forward to Ao Qing's answer.

Hearing this, Ao Qing said proudly: "Of course."

Hearing Ao Qing's answer, the dragons could no longer suppress their inner joy and were ecstatic.

The entire dragon domain was shaking wildly at this moment.

"Lord Longzi, where is the prophet now?"

Ao Qing pointed to the direction of the distant sky and said lightly: "Desolate City."

Desolate City? !

The dragons were a little surprised, because not long ago they were still discussing whether to go to the deserted city to find out.

Because the rumor of this deserted city is extremely powerful, and more importantly, this deserted city is a human force.

"Ah Qing, what's going on? Why didn't you bring the prophet back to the dragon clan?"

At this time, Ao Lie asked with a frown.

Obviously, he was a little dissatisfied with his son's behavior.

Hearing this, Ao Qing's mouth twitched slightly.

It's so easy to say. I don't know how long I will have to ask for the young master to come to the Dragon Clan.

Moreover, Lu Xue just went through that kind of thing. I'm afraid that even if I don't have this dragon face, I can't invite her.

Thinking of that incident, Ao Qing also instantly remembered his purpose.

"Dad, put that matter aside for now. I have something very important to tell you."

Hearing this, Ao Lie asked in confusion: "Very important thing? What is it?"

Only to hear Ao Qing said directly: "Give me the position of the patriarch."

......

"Are you kidding?!"

Ao Lie said angrily.

He finally got a big bargain and became the patriarch of the Dragon Clan. How could he easily give it up to someone else, not even his own son.

Looking at his father's extremely reluctant look.

Ao Qing snorted.

It seems that he is now interested in the position of the patriarch of the Dragon Clan.

He is much better off in the deserted city than in the Dragon Clan.

"Dad, you need to look further ahead. Give me the position of the clan leader. I can lead the dragon clan to an infinitely glorious road."

Ao Qing said at this time.

Ao Lie snorted and said, "Then tell me what you will do to lead the dragon clan to an infinitely glorious road."

Ao Qing shook his head, stretched out his little claws, and pointed to the sky.

"That's easy. Just let the dragon clan join the deserted city."

Hearing this, the scene was silent for a moment.

The next moment, countless breaths gushed out.

"Impossible!"

"Let my dragon clan succumb to other forces, it would be better to kill me!"

"Lord Longzi, be careful with your words!"

Even Ao Lie stared at Ao Qing with some anger.

"A Qing, do you know what you are saying?"

"My dragon clan has been passed down for endless years. How can we rely on other forces to survive? My dragon clan would rather die standing than live on our knees!"

As soon as these words came out, all the dragons looked at Ao Lie with respect.

"The clan leader said it well!"

"Lord Longzi, you should learn from your father on this point."

Looking at the reactions of the dragons, Ao Qing frowned.

Desolate City, that is a place full of infinite opportunities.

Now, the dragon clan has the conditions to enter the Desolate City, but the clan members are unwilling.

After a moment of silence, Ao Qing said in a deep voice: "Dad, what I said is true, Desolate City is not simple, and the prophet you are talking about is the daughter of the Lord of Desolate City."

Hearing Ao Qing's words, all the dragons were stunned.

The prophet.

The daughter of the Lord of Desolate City.

Ao Lie's pupils also shrank slightly, and countless possibilities appeared in his mind at this time.

And at this moment, a terrifying breath surged from the depths of the Dragon Domain.

Feeling the terrifying breath and the sound of dragon roars, the dragons exclaimed: "The ancestor has come out of retreat!"

Sure enough, as soon as the voice fell, the next moment, an extremely huge body appeared above the Dragon Domain.

The overwhelming sense of oppression came over him.

At this time, the shadows of the dragons in the void were like babies and adults.

"Ao Qing, do you know your crime!"

A majestic voice came from the void.

A terrifying pressure rolled over Ao Qing below.

Suddenly, Ao Qing's face changed slightly, but his body did not retreat at all.

After countless years of precipitation in the deserted city, Ao Qing had already been reborn. Even when facing the pressure of the strong men of the same clan, Ao Qing was not afraid.

Looking into the void, Ao Qing's expression was a little solemn.

"Ancestor, what crime did Ao Qing commit?"

At this time, the voice came again, mixed with the terrifying dragon power, and it lasted for a long time.

"You are the son of my dragon clan, but you instigated my dragon clan to become the mount of others. You have lost the face of my dragon clan, and you still don't know your crime!"

At this moment, the ancestor of the dragon clan was extremely angry.

He even doubted the prophecy of that year.

Ao Qing is really a great contributor to the dragon clan, and does the person who predicted it really exist?

Hearing this, Ao Qing looked ugly and was about to refute, but Ao Lie said with an ugly face: "A Qing, you should admit your mistake to the ancestor!"

Then Ao Lie prayed to the void: "Ancestor, my son Ao Qing was also instigated by someone with intentions and lost his mind. Please forgive me, ancestor."

"Dad,"

Looking at Ao Lie, Ao Qing hesitated.

He knew that the dragon clan was getting worse and worse.

But even so, the dragon clan was still arrogant and looked down on almost everyone.

If this continues, the dragon clan will inevitably face a catastrophe.

Just as he was thinking hard about the plan, the ancestor of the dragon clan said: "From now on, strip Ao Qing of his identity as a dragon son, and lock him up in the Dragon Valley to reflect for a thousand years!"

Then, a huge dragon claw reached out from the void towards Ao Qing.

Looking at the giant claw carrying a terrifying aura, Ao Qing's eyelids jumped, "Master, save me!"

Boom!

The next moment, a huge roar sounded.

Ao Qing stared blankly at the petite figure in front of him.

Who is this?

At this time, all the dragon clan members looked at the figure in horror.

He actually blocked the ancestor's attack with one hand!

It's the human race!

Who is he?

At this time, the human man in front of Ao Qing stared at the huge phantom in the void indifferently, then turned his head to look at Ao Qing, and said lightly: "The city lord has ordered me to protect you."

Hearing this, Ao Qing's eyes suddenly turned red.

This master, I cry to death

"Who are you?"

The ancestor of the dragon clan stretched out the huge dragon head from the void and said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the human man said coldly: "You are not qualified to know my identity."

In this world, he will only listen to the orders of one person, that is the lord of the deserted city, Lu Daosheng.

It was Lu Daosheng who extended a helping hand to him when he was most desperate in his life and gave him the opportunity to become a strong man.

From then on, he lived to complete the tasks assigned by Lu Daosheng.

Hearing these extremely arrogant words, the ancestor of the dragon clan suddenly looked angry.

"I don't care who you are, if you dare to come to my dragon clan to make trouble, you will be crushed to pieces!"

Boom!

The huge dragon tail swung straight down.

The entire void was shattered at this moment!

Seeing this, Ao Qing was directly shocked.

Is his ancestor going to kill him as well?

And Ao Lie also looked at this scene with an unbelievable look on his face.

This is his only son!

Buzz——

A dark light flashed, and the human man immediately took Ao Qing back a hundred feet away.

At this time, a cry of surprise came from the void.

"Death Mark! Who are you?!"

The Dragon Clan ancestor looked at the strange glowing mark in the human man's hand in horror.

Just now, it was the power that exploded in the mark that blocked his attack.

And the realm of this human man is also clear at a glance.

Heavenly Man Realm.
